scope.method: Enumerated top-level JSONL sessions by modification time descending, searched install/toolchain/package-manager terms, then inspected matched user prompts, tool calls, adjacent tool results and relevant assistant summaries. No other Claude project was read.

intent.summary: The user wants deterministic, repeatable engineering workflows spanning technical layers, vertical integrations and cross-cutting concerns, with agent-first structural tools and evidence-driven gates. They specifically asked for tools around API/data/schema mapping and C4/system diagrams.

sources.note: Asked for a bidirectional database-to-client map including tools, dependencies, versions, latency, internal layers and junctions, and CLI tools familiar to agents.
Asked about structured tools to make the setup deterministic, especially C4 diagrams, and agent-first tools.
Requested a robust, deterministic, layered workflow for vertical integrations and concerns repeated within layers.
Asked to install needed CLI tools and set up workflows across layers, integrations, interlayer work and cross-cutting concerns.

tools.name: LikeC4 CLI
tools.platform: project root devDependency, run through pnpm; no global install shown
tools.verification: pnpm result confirms dependency added; assistant reports MCP responded as LikeC4 1.60.0 with 20 tools and answered a model query (session line 5632). No direct CLI version/validate result captured in this excerpt.

tools.name: @likec4/mcp
tools.platform: project root devDependency; assistant describes MCP as stdio with LIKEC4_WORKSPACE; no .mcp.json existed during an earlier check
tools.verification: Dependency addition confirmed; later assistant reports a responding server with 20 tools. Whether MCP registration was completed is not established by the captured install result.

tools.name: Syft
tools.platform: Windows winget package; executable alias available via WinGet Links on the Windows host
tools.verification: winget reported successfully installed and added syft alias. `syft version` reported 1.55.0. First attempted scan used dir: on a file and failed; retry with file: produced CycloneDX 1.7 JSON with 3,996 components from pnpm-lock.yaml.

tools.name: Grafana k6
tools.verification: Not installed by this attempt: tool output says user cancelled; installer exited 1602. Earlier path probe showed `k6` absent.

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.platform: Windows winget; invoked from Bash/WSL with Windows WinGet Links appended to PATH
tools.verification: winget reported an existing installation and attempted upgrade; subsequent version command reported 8.30.1. The install result did not say upgrade succeeded, but usable version was confirmed. A history scan ran over main-dev..HEAD (574 commits) and reported 1,532 generic-secret matches, prominently XML/device-run reports; this is a noisy baseline, not proof all findings are real secrets.

tools.name: OSV-Scanner
tools.platform: Windows winget; invoked from Bash/WSL with WinGet Links path
tools.verification: Installer output says successfully verified installer hash; version command confirmed 2.7.0. A pnpm-lock.yaml scan reported 63 vulnerable packages and 252 advisories (2 critical, 124 high, 97 moderate, 29 low). This is the captured scan output, not independently assessed applicability.

tools.name: Schemathesis
tools.platform: uv isolated tool installation on Windows user environment; invoked from Bash/WSL with C:/Users/Naween/.local/bin in PATH
tools.verification: uv reported installing two executables; `schemathesis --version` reported 4.33.1. Registry check found 4.33.2 released that day, so 4.33.1 was selected as newest version older than 24 hours. No API conformance run is shown here.

tools.name: Spectral CLI
tools.platform: project root devDependency, run through pnpm
tools.verification: Dependency add command output included a pnpm approve-builds notice; subsequent `pnpm exec spectral --version` reported 6.17.1. Exact-pin intent is explicit in command.

tools.name: squawk-cli
tools.platform: project root devDependency, run through pnpm
tools.verification: pnpm confirmed dependency added; `pnpm exec squawk --version` reported 2.72.0. Later assistant said a schema ledger, Squawk and docs were committed, but commit outcome is not used here as package installation proof.

otherCheckedTools.note: The probe preceded installation of some listed absent tools; it is a historical snapshot, not current status.

intentInterpretation.confidence: direct for stated goal; inferred for tool-to-goal fit
intentInterpretation.note: The install requests support the user's stated goal of deterministic, agent-friendly layer, interface and cross-cutting workflows. Tool choice and workflow integration are assistant-selected implementation details; the user prompt did not specify these package names, exact versions, or gates.

limitations: Source window is top-level C--x Claude JSONL sessions modified from 2026-11-04 onward; it is not a complete audit of installed machine software.
No global package environment or executable state was inspected directly; install/version conclusions rely on recorded tool results.

WSL was the invocation shell for package-manager calls that used /c/x; the installed Winget executables and uv tool environment are Windows-side. No Linux cargo, pipx or Scoop installs were found in the inspected Nov 11 region.
Other sessions inside the seven-day boundary were searched for installation commands; no additional install command matching the package managers was found.
